definition.name: olap_borrowers_analytics
definition.view_definition:
SELECT old_view."Row ID",
    old_view."Borrower Name",
    old_view."Description",
    old_view."Creation Date",
    old_view."Hidden Flag",
    old_view."Communication Name",
    old_view."Instagram Username",
    old_view."AI Collection Enabled",
    old_view."City",
    old_view."Working Location",
    old_view."Address",
    old_view."Total Interest Earned",
    old_view."Total Amount Loaned",
    old_view."Total Number of Loans",
    old_view."Total Outstanding Principal",
    old_view."Active Loan Interest Earned",
    old_view."Active Daily Interest",
    old_view."Has Closed Loan",
    old_view."Has Active Loan",
    old_view."Ref Referrer",
    old_view."Return on Active Principal",
    old_view."Profit Last 30 Days",
    old_view."Projected Interest Coverage Date",
    old_view."Closed Loan Interest Earned",
    old_view."Closed Loan Principle",
    old_view."Return on Closed Loans",
    old_view."30D Gross Principal Days",
    old_view."30D Principal Reduction Days",
    old_view."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
    old_view."30D Return on Average Principal",
    old_view."Daily Collection Status",
    old_view."Todays Amount Due",
    old_view."Todays Amount Collected",
    old_view."Todays Amount Remaining",
    old_view."Portfolio Exposure %",
    old_view."Active Loan Count",
    old_view."Oldest Active Loan Age",
    old_view."Overdue Amount",
    old_view."Overdue Charge Count",
    old_view."Historical Charge Count",
    old_view."On Time Charge Count",
    old_view."Lifetime On Time Rate",
    old_view."Recent 30D Charge Count",
    old_view."Recent 30D On Time Count",
    old_view."Recent 30D On Time Rate",
    old_view."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
    old_view."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
    old_view."Maximum Days Late",
    old_view."Last Late Payment Date",
    old_view."Largest Successful Loan",
    old_view."Average Successful Loan Size",
    old_view."Default Count",
    old_view."Lifetime Default Loss",
    old_view."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
    old_view."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
    old_view."Matrix Active Borrower Count",
    old_view."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
    old_view."Matrix Economic Contribution",
    old_view."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
    old_view."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
    old_view."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
    old_view."Matrix Current Condition Score",
    old_view."Matrix History Sufficient",
    old_view."Matrix Stability Score",
    old_view."Matrix Quadrant",
    old_view."Profit Last 10 Days",
    old_view."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
    old_view."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
    b."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
    b."Payment Request Cash Account",
    b."Payment Request Token"
   FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                 SELECT q.d,
                    date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
                    (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
                   FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
                ), lr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS active,
                    max(l."Loan Age Days") FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS oldest,
                    GREATEST(0::numeric, max(l."Principal Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text AND l."Defaulted" = false)) AS largest,
                    COALESCE(avg(l."Principal Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text AND l."Defaulted" = false), 0::numeric) AS average_success,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted" = true) AS defaults,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."Default Loss Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted" = true), 0::numeric) AS loss,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."30D Principal Days"), 0::numeric) AS gross_days,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."Expected Interest This Month"), 0::numeric) AS forecast,
                    bool_or(l."Defaulted" = true AND l."Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric) AS current_default
                   FROM olap_loans_analytics l
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), rr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= (ctx.d - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d AND r."Interest Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit30,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= (ctx.d - 10) AND r."Payment Date" < ctx.d AND r."Interest Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit10,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND r."Payment Date" <= ctx.me), 0::numeric) AS mtd,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."30D Principal Reduction Days"), 0::numeric) AS reduction
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
                     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), cash AS (
                 SELECT c."Ref Collection Borrower" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Amount Received"), 0::numeric) AS collected
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
                     JOIN olap_charges_analytics c ON c."Row ID" = r."Ref Charges"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  WHERE r."Payment Date" = ctx.d AND c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY c."Ref Collection Borrower"
                ), cr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text), 0::numeric) AS overdue,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS overdue_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Historical On Time") AS ontime,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS recent_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical On Time") AS recent_ontime,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Historical Late") AS late_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical Late") AS recent_late,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late")) AS max_late,
                    max(c."Charge Date") FILTER (WHERE c."Days Late" > 0) AS last_late,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 180) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history180,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 180) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical On Time") AS ontime180,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history90,
                    bool_or(l."Defaulted") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS default90,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d)) AS late90,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric)) AS unpaid_late,
                    bool_or(c."Total Paid" > 0::numeric) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" = ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric) AS partial_today,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" = ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric) AS unpaid_today,
                    min(c."Charge Date") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS first_history,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL) AS collection_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS collection_overdue,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" < (ctx.d - 7) AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS collection_long_overdue,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'รอชำระ'::text) AS collection_pending,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระบางส่วน'::text) AS collection_partial,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS collection_paid,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Due") FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS collection_due,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS collection_remaining,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS interest_remaining
                   FROM olap_charges_analytics c
                     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), er AS (
                 SELECT "Business Expenses"."Ref Payee Borrower" AS id,
                    sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) AS rebate
                   FROM "Business Expenses"
                  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Source Type" = 'Referral Rebate'::text
                  GROUP BY "Business Expenses"."Ref Payee Borrower"
                ), pt AS (
                 SELECT COALESCE(sum("Loans"."Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS portfolio
                   FROM "Loans"
                ), bt AS (
                 SELECT COALESCE(sum("Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS borrower_portfolio,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "Borrowers"."Has Active Loan" = true) AS active_borrowers
                   FROM "Borrowers"
                ), a AS (
                 SELECT b_1."Row ID",
                    b_1."Borrower Name",
                    b_1."Description",
                    b_1."Creation Date",
                    b_1."Hidden Flag",
                    b_1."Communication Name",
                    b_1."Instagram Username",
                    b_1."AI Collection Enabled",
                    b_1."City",
                    b_1."Working Location",
                    b_1."Address",
                    b_1."Total Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Total Amount Loaned",
                    b_1."Total Number of Loans",
                    b_1."Total Outstanding Principal",
                    b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Active Daily Interest",
                    b_1."Has Closed Loan",
                    b_1."Has Active Loan",
                    b_1."Ref Referrer",
                    b_1."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
                    b_1."Payment Request Cash Account",
                    b_1."Payment Request Token",
                    b_1."Borrower Note",
                        CASE
                            WHEN b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned" / b_1."Total Outstanding Principal"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Return on Active Principal",
                    COALESCE(rr.profit30, 0::numeric) AS "Profit Last 30 Days",
                    COALESCE(rr.profit10, 0::numeric) AS "Profit Last 10 Days",
                        CASE
                            WHEN b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" <= 0::numeric THEN NULL::date
                            WHEN b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned" >= b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" THEN ctx.d
                            WHEN b_1."Active Daily Interest" > 0::numeric THEN ctx.d + ceil((b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" - b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned") / b_1."Active Daily Interest")::integer
                            ELSE NULL::date
                        END AS "Projected Interest Coverage Date",
                    COALESCE(b_1."Total Interest Earned", 0::numeric) - COALESCE(b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned", 0::numeric) AS "Closed Loan Interest Earned",
                    COALESCE(b_1."Total Amount Loaned", 0::numeric) - COALESCE(b_1."Total Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) AS "Closed Loan Principle",
                    COALESCE(lr.gross_days, 0::numeric) AS "30D Gross Principal Days",
                    COALESCE(rr.reduction, 0::numeric) AS "30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    round((COALESCE(lr.gross_days, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.reduction, 0::numeric)) / 30::numeric) AS "30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(cr.collection_count, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN NULL::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_long_overdue > 0 THEN 'Long Overdue'::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_overdue > 0 THEN 'Overdue'::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_pending = 0 AND cr.collection_partial = 0 THEN 'Fully Paid'::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_partial > 0 OR cr.collection_paid > 0 AND cr.collection_pending > 0 THEN 'Partially Paid'::text
                            ELSE 'Not Paid'::text
                        END AS "Daily Collection Status",
                    COALESCE(cr.collection_due, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Due",
                    COALESCE(cash.collected, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Collected",
                    COALESCE(cr.collection_remaining, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Remaining",
                        CASE
                            WHEN bt.borrower_portfolio = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                            ELSE COALESCE(b_1."Total Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) / bt.borrower_portfolio
                        END AS "Portfolio Exposure %",
                    COALESCE(lr.active, 0::bigint) AS "Active Loan Count",
                    COALESCE(lr.oldest, 0) AS "Oldest Active Loan Age",
                    COALESCE(cr.overdue, 0::numeric) AS "Overdue Amount",
                    COALESCE(cr.overdue_count, 0::bigint) AS "Overdue Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.history, 0::bigint) AS "Historical Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.ontime, 0::bigint) AS "On Time Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_count, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_ontime, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D On Time Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.late_count, 0::bigint) AS "Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_late, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.max_late, 0) AS "Maximum Days Late",
                    cr.last_late AS "Last Late Payment Date",
                    COALESCE(lr.largest, 0::numeric) AS "Largest Successful Loan",
                    round(COALESCE(lr.average_success, 0::numeric)) AS "Average Successful Loan Size",
                    COALESCE(lr.defaults, 0::bigint) AS "Default Count",
                    COALESCE(lr.loss, 0::numeric) AS "Lifetime Default Loss",
                    pt.portfolio AS "Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                    COALESCE(rr.mtd, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(cr.interest_remaining, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(lr.forecast, 0::numeric) AS "Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                    bt.active_borrowers AS "Matrix Active Borrower Count",
                    1 / NULLIF(bt.active_borrowers, 0) AS "Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
                    cr.recent_ontime * 100 / NULLIF(cr.recent_count, 0) AS "Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                    cr.ontime180 * 100 / NULLIF(cr.history180, 0) AS "Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(cr.history90, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN NULL::integer
                            WHEN cr.default90 THEN 0
                            WHEN cr.late90 = 0 THEN 100
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 1 THEN 90
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 3 THEN 70
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 7 THEN 40
                            ELSE 10
                        END AS "Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                        CASE
                            WHEN lr.current_default THEN 0
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late > 3 THEN 20
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late >= 2 THEN 40
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late >= 1 THEN 60
                            WHEN cr.partial_today THEN 75
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_today > 0 THEN 90
                            ELSE 100
                        END AS "Matrix Current Condition Score",
                    COALESCE((ctx.d - cr.first_history) >= 3, true) AS "Matrix History Sufficient",
                    COALESCE(er.rebate, 0::numeric) AS "Total Referral Rebate Earned"
                   FROM "Borrowers" b_1
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                     CROSS JOIN pt
                     CROSS JOIN bt
                     LEFT JOIN lr ON lr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN cash ON cash.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN er ON er.id = b_1."Row ID"
                ), b AS (
                 SELECT a."Row ID",
                    a."Borrower Name",
                    a."Description",
                    a."Creation Date",
                    a."Hidden Flag",
                    a."Communication Name",
                    a."Instagram Username",
                    a."AI Collection Enabled",
                    a."City",
                    a."Working Location",
                    a."Address",
                    a."Total Interest Earned",
                    a."Total Amount Loaned",
                    a."Total Number of Loans",
                    a."Total Outstanding Principal",
                    a."Active Loan Interest Earned",
                    a."Active Daily Interest",
                    a."Has Closed Loan",
                    a."Has Active Loan",
                    a."Ref Referrer",
                    a."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
                    a."Payment Request Cash Account",
                    a."Payment Request Token",
                    a."Borrower Note",
                    a."Return on Active Principal",
                    a."Profit Last 30 Days",
                    a."Profit Last 10 Days",
                    a."Projected Interest Coverage Date",
                    a."Closed Loan Interest Earned",
                    a."Closed Loan Principle",
                    a."30D Gross Principal Days",
                    a."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    a."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                    a."Daily Collection Status",
                    a."Todays Amount Due",
                    a."Todays Amount Collected",
                    a."Todays Amount Remaining",
                    a."Portfolio Exposure %",
                    a."Active Loan Count",
                    a."Oldest Active Loan Age",
                    a."Overdue Amount",
                    a."Overdue Charge Count",
                    a."Historical Charge Count",
                    a."On Time Charge Count",
                    a."Recent 30D Charge Count",
                    a."Recent 30D On Time Count",
                    a."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                    a."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
                    a."Maximum Days Late",
                    a."Last Late Payment Date",
                    a."Largest Successful Loan",
                    a."Average Successful Loan Size",
                    a."Default Count",
                    a."Lifetime Default Loss",
                    a."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                    a."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                    a."Matrix Active Borrower Count",
                    a."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
                    a."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                    a."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                    a."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                    a."Matrix Current Condition Score",
                    a."Matrix History Sufficient",
                    a."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Has Closed Loan" AND a."Closed Loan Principle" > 0::numeric THEN a."Closed Loan Interest Earned" / a."Closed Loan Principle"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Return on Closed Loans",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."30D Average Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN a."Profit Last 30 Days" / a."30D Average Outstanding Principal"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "30D Return on Average Principal",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Historical Charge Count" = 0 THEN 0::bigint
                            ELSE a."On Time Charge Count" / a."Historical Charge Count"
                        END AS "Lifetime On Time Rate",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Recent 30D Charge Count" = 0 THEN 0::bigint
                            ELSE a."Recent 30D On Time Count" / a."Recent 30D Charge Count"
                        END AS "Recent 30D On Time Rate",
                        CASE
                            WHEN sum(a."Profit Last 10 Days") FILTER (WHERE a."Has Active Loan") OVER () > 0::numeric THEN round(a."Profit Last 10 Days" / sum(a."Profit Last 10 Days") FILTER (WHERE a."Has Active Loan") OVER (), 2)
                            ELSE NULL::numeric
                        END AS "Matrix Economic Contribution",
                    trunc(round(10::numeric * (COALESCE(a."Matrix Recent Reliability Score"::numeric * 0.45, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(a."Matrix Historical Reliability Score"::numeric * 0.20, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(a."Matrix Delay Severity Score"::numeric * 0.20, 0::numeric) + a."Matrix Current Condition Score"::numeric * 0.15) / (
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Matrix Recent Reliability Score" IS NOT NULL THEN 0.45
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END +
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Matrix Historical Reliability Score" IS NOT NULL THEN 0.20
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END +
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Matrix Delay Severity Score" IS NOT NULL THEN 0.20
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END + 0.15)) / 10::numeric) AS "Matrix Stability Score"
                   FROM a
                ), c AS (
                 SELECT b_1."Row ID",
                    b_1."Borrower Name",
                    b_1."Description",
                    b_1."Creation Date",
                    b_1."Hidden Flag",
                    b_1."Communication Name",
                    b_1."Instagram Username",
                    b_1."AI Collection Enabled",
                    b_1."City",
                    b_1."Working Location",
                    b_1."Address",
                    b_1."Total Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Total Amount Loaned",
                    b_1."Total Number of Loans",
                    b_1."Total Outstanding Principal",
                    b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Active Daily Interest",
                    b_1."Has Closed Loan",
                    b_1."Has Active Loan",
                    b_1."Ref Referrer",
                    b_1."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
                    b_1."Payment Request Cash Account",
                    b_1."Payment Request Token",
                    b_1."Borrower Note",
                    b_1."Return on Active Principal",
                    b_1."Profit Last 30 Days",
                    b_1."Profit Last 10 Days",
                    b_1."Projected Interest Coverage Date",
                    b_1."Closed Loan Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Closed Loan Principle",
                    b_1."30D Gross Principal Days",
                    b_1."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    b_1."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                    b_1."Daily Collection Status",
                    b_1."Todays Amount Due",
                    b_1."Todays Amount Collected",
                    b_1."Todays Amount Remaining",
                    b_1."Portfolio Exposure %",
                    b_1."Active Loan Count",
                    b_1."Oldest Active Loan Age",
                    b_1."Overdue Amount",
                    b_1."Overdue Charge Count",
                    b_1."Historical Charge Count",
                    b_1."On Time Charge Count",
                    b_1."Recent 30D Charge Count",
                    b_1."Recent 30D On Time Count",
                    b_1."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                    b_1."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
                    b_1."Maximum Days Late",
                    b_1."Last Late Payment Date",
                    b_1."Largest Successful Loan",
                    b_1."Average Successful Loan Size",
                    b_1."Default Count",
                    b_1."Lifetime Default Loss",
                    b_1."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                    b_1."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                    b_1."Matrix Active Borrower Count",
                    b_1."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
                    b_1."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                    b_1."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                    b_1."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                    b_1."Matrix Current Condition Score",
                    b_1."Matrix History Sufficient",
                    b_1."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
                    b_1."Return on Closed Loans",
                    b_1."30D Return on Average Principal",
                    b_1."Lifetime On Time Rate",
                    b_1."Recent 30D On Time Rate",
                    b_1."Matrix Economic Contribution",
                    b_1."Matrix Stability Score",
                    LEAST(1::numeric, COALESCE(b_1."Matrix Economic Contribution", 0::numeric) * b_1."Matrix Active Borrower Count"::numeric / 2::numeric) AS "Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution"
                   FROM b b_1
                ), final AS (
                 SELECT c."Row ID",
                    c."Borrower Name",
                    c."Description",
                    c."Creation Date",
                    c."Hidden Flag",
                    c."Communication Name",
                    c."Instagram Username",
                    c."AI Collection Enabled",
                    c."City",
                    c."Working Location",
                    c."Address",
                    c."Total Interest Earned",
                    c."Total Amount Loaned",
                    c."Total Number of Loans",
                    c."Total Outstanding Principal",
                    c."Active Loan Interest Earned",
                    c."Active Daily Interest",
                    c."Has Closed Loan",
                    c."Has Active Loan",
                    c."Ref Referrer",
                    c."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
                    c."Payment Request Cash Account",
                    c."Payment Request Token",
                    c."Borrower Note",
                    c."Return on Active Principal",
                    c."Profit Last 30 Days",
                    c."Profit Last 10 Days",
                    c."Projected Interest Coverage Date",
                    c."Closed Loan Interest Earned",
                    c."Closed Loan Principle",
                    c."30D Gross Principal Days",
                    c."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    c."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                    c."Daily Collection Status",
                    c."Todays Amount Due",
                    c."Todays Amount Collected",
                    c."Todays Amount Remaining",
                    c."Portfolio Exposure %",
                    c."Active Loan Count",
                    c."Oldest Active Loan Age",
                    c."Overdue Amount",
                    c."Overdue Charge Count",
                    c."Historical Charge Count",
                    c."On Time Charge Count",
                    c."Recent 30D Charge Count",
                    c."Recent 30D On Time Count",
                    c."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                    c."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
                    c."Maximum Days Late",
                    c."Last Late Payment Date",
                    c."Largest Successful Loan",
                    c."Average Successful Loan Size",
                    c."Default Count",
                    c."Lifetime Default Loss",
                    c."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                    c."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                    c."Matrix Active Borrower Count",
                    c."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
                    c."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                    c."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                    c."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                    c."Matrix Current Condition Score",
                    c."Matrix History Sufficient",
                    c."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
                    c."Return on Closed Loans",
                    c."30D Return on Average Principal",
                    c."Lifetime On Time Rate",
                    c."Recent 30D On Time Rate",
                    c."Matrix Economic Contribution",
                    c."Matrix Stability Score",
                    c."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
                        CASE
                            WHEN c."Has Active Loan" = false THEN NULL::text
                            WHEN c."Matrix Economic Contribution" IS NULL OR c."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution" IS NULL THEN 'Unclassified'::text
                            WHEN c."Matrix History Sufficient" = false THEN 'Provisional - insufficient history'::text
                            WHEN c."Matrix Economic Contribution" >= c."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark"::numeric AND c."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution" >= 0.5 THEN 'Star'::text
                            WHEN c."Matrix Economic Contribution" < c."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark"::numeric AND c."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution" >= 0.5 THEN 'Cash Cow'::text
                            WHEN c."Matrix Economic Contribution" >= c."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark"::numeric AND c."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution" < 0.5 THEN 'Question Mark'::text
                            ELSE 'Dog'::text
                        END AS "Matrix Quadrant"
                   FROM c
                )
         SELECT x."Row ID",
            x."Borrower Name",
            x."Description",
            x."Creation Date",
            x."Hidden Flag",
            x."Communication Name",
            x."Instagram Username",
            x."AI Collection Enabled",
            x."City",
            x."Working Location",
            x."Address",
            x."Total Interest Earned",
            x."Total Amount Loaned",
            x."Total Number of Loans",
            x."Total Outstanding Principal",
            x."Active Loan Interest Earned",
            x."Active Daily Interest",
            x."Has Closed Loan",
            x."Has Active Loan",
            x."Ref Referrer",
            round(x."Return on Active Principal", 2) AS "Return on Active Principal",
            round(x."Profit Last 30 Days", 0) AS "Profit Last 30 Days",
            x."Projected Interest Coverage Date",
            round(x."Closed Loan Interest Earned", 0) AS "Closed Loan Interest Earned",
            round(x."Closed Loan Principle", 0) AS "Closed Loan Principle",
            round(x."Return on Closed Loans", 2) AS "Return on Closed Loans",
            round(x."30D Gross Principal Days", 0) AS "30D Gross Principal Days",
            round(x."30D Principal Reduction Days", 0) AS "30D Principal Reduction Days",
            round(x."30D Average Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "30D Average Outstanding Principal",
            round(x."30D Return on Average Principal", 2) AS "30D Return on Average Principal",
            x."Daily Collection Status",
            round(x."Todays Amount Due", 0) AS "Todays Amount Due",
            round(x."Todays Amount Collected", 0) AS "Todays Amount Collected",
            round(x."Todays Amount Remaining", 0) AS "Todays Amount Remaining",
            round(x."Portfolio Exposure %", 4) AS "Portfolio Exposure %",
            x."Active Loan Count",
            x."Oldest Active Loan Age",
            round(x."Overdue Amount", 0) AS "Overdue Amount",
            x."Overdue Charge Count",
            x."Historical Charge Count",
            x."On Time Charge Count",
            round(x."Lifetime On Time Rate"::numeric, 4) AS "Lifetime On Time Rate",
            x."Recent 30D Charge Count",
            x."Recent 30D On Time Count",
            round(x."Recent 30D On Time Rate"::numeric, 4) AS "Recent 30D On Time Rate",
            x."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
            x."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
            x."Maximum Days Late",
            x."Last Late Payment Date",
            round(x."Largest Successful Loan", 2) AS "Largest Successful Loan",
            round(x."Average Successful Loan Size", 2) AS "Average Successful Loan Size",
            x."Default Count",
            round(x."Lifetime Default Loss", 2) AS "Lifetime Default Loss",
            round(x."Portfolio Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
            round(x."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution", 0) AS "Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
            x."Matrix Active Borrower Count",
            round(x."Matrix Equal Share Benchmark"::numeric, 4) AS "Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
            round(x."Matrix Economic Contribution", 2) AS "Matrix Economic Contribution",
            x."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
            x."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
            x."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
            x."Matrix Current Condition Score",
            x."Matrix History Sufficient",
            x."Matrix Stability Score",
            x."Matrix Quadrant",
            round(x."Profit Last 10 Days", 0) AS "Profit Last 10 Days",
            round(x."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution", 4) AS "Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
            round(x."Total Referral Rebate Earned", 0) AS "Total Referral Rebate Earned"
           FROM final x) old_view
     JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = old_view."Row ID";

definition.name: olap_portfolio_summary
definition.view_definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), lr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS principal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS active,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Interest This Month"), 0::numeric) AS forecast,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Principal Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS days,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Daily Interest Amount"), 0::numeric) AS daily,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Total Interest Received") FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text), 0::numeric) AS active_profit
           FROM olap_loans_analytics
        ), rr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS today,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" = (ctx.d - 1)), 0::numeric) AS yesterday,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" <= ctx.me), 0::numeric) AS mtd,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Principal Returned Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS returned_days,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_a,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_b
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), cr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS interest,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Due") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS due,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Total Paid") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS paid,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS remaining
           FROM olap_charges_analytics
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), br AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Fully Paid'::text) AS full_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Partially Paid'::text) AS partial_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Overdue'::text) AS overdue_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Not Paid'::text) AS notpaid_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Long Overdue'::text) AS long_overdue_count
           FROM olap_borrowers_analytics
        ), top3 AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(q.v), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM ( SELECT "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" AS v
                   FROM "Borrowers"
                  WHERE "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric
                  ORDER BY "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" DESC
                 LIMIT 3) q
        ), pool AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions"
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Settlements" s
             JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
          WHERE s."Status" = 'Completed'::text
        ), earned AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE p."Partner Role"
                    WHEN 'A'::text THEN rr.profit_a
                    WHEN 'B'::text THEN rr.profit_b
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Partners" p
             CROSS JOIN rr
        ), er AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total,
            COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS mtd
           FROM "Business Expenses"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), recent AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Snapshot Date",
            a."Generated At",
            a."Model Version",
            a."Principal Issued",
            a."Loans Issued",
            a."Principal Returned",
            a."Interest Received",
            a."Repayments Count",
            a."Outstanding Principal EOD",
            a."Active Loans EOD",
            a."Active Borrowers EOD",
            a."Pending Charges EOD",
            a."Total Cash Pool EOD",
            a."Available Cash EOD",
            a."Unsettled Profit EOD",
            a."Business Expenses",
            a."Net Profit",
            a."Net Unsettled Profit EOD",
            a."Capital Contributed",
            a."Capital Withdrawn",
            a."Partner Settlements",
            a."Partner A Net Profit",
            a."Partner B Net Profit",
            a."Partner A Settlements",
            a."Partner B Settlements",
            a."Cash Money In",
            a."Cash Money Out",
            a."Cash Opening Balance",
            a."Cash Balance EOD",
            a."Cash Available From",
            a."Cash Balance Status"
           FROM "Daily Analytics" a
          WHERE a."Snapshot Date" >= ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) - '30 days'::interval)
        ), peak AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(max(recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS amount
           FROM recent
        ), peakdate AS (
         SELECT max(recent."Snapshot Date") AS dt
           FROM recent
             CROSS JOIN peak
          WHERE recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric = peak.amount
        ), a AS (
         SELECT s."Row ID",
            s."Statistics ID",
            rr.profit AS "Total Profit",
            lr.principal AS "Outstanding Principal",
            lr.principal AS "Total Outstanding Principal",
            lr.active AS "Active Loans",
            rr.today AS "Today's Profit",
            rr.yesterday AS "Yesterday's Profit",
            rr.mtd AS "Realized Profit MTD",
            rr.mtd + cr.interest + lr.forecast AS "Projected Monthly Profit",
            cr.pending AS "Pending Payment Amount",
            lr.forecast AS "Forecast Remaining Interest",
            cr.interest AS "Today's Outstanding Interest",
            lr.days - rr.returned_days AS "Net Principal Days MTD",
            lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric AS "Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
            round((lr.days - rr.returned_days + lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric) / EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.me)) AS "Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
            peak.amount AS "Peak Cash Pool 30D",
            peakdate.dt AS "Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
            lr.daily AS "Expected Daily Interest",
            lr.active_profit AS "Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal > 0::numeric THEN lr.active_profit / lr.principal
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
            pool.total AS "Total Cash Pool",
            earned.total - settled.total AS "Total Unsettled Profit",
            pool.total - lr.principal + earned.total - settled.total AS "Expected Loan Account Balance",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE top3.total / lr.principal
                END AS "Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
            br.full_count AS "Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
            br.partial_count AS "Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
            br.overdue_count AS "Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
            br.notpaid_count AS "Borrowers Not Paid Today",
            cr.due AS "Amount Due Today",
            cr.paid AS "Amount Collected Today",
            cr.remaining AS "Amount Outstanding Today",
                CASE
                    WHEN cr.due = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE cr.paid / cr.due
                END AS "Amount Collection Rate Today",
            er.total AS "Total Business Expenses",
            rr.profit - er.total AS "Net Profit",
            er.mtd AS "Expenses MTD",
            rr.mtd - er.mtd AS "Net Profit MTD",
            earned.total - settled.total - er.total AS "Net Unsettled Profit",
            pool.total - lr.principal + earned.total - settled.total - er.total AS "Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
            rr.mtd AS "Operating Income MTD",
            - er.mtd AS "Income Statement Expenses MTD",
            br.long_overdue_count AS "Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment"
           FROM "Statistics" s
             CROSS JOIN ctx
             CROSS JOIN lr
             CROSS JOIN rr
             CROSS JOIN cr
             CROSS JOIN br
             CROSS JOIN top3
             CROSS JOIN pool
             CROSS JOIN settled
             CROSS JOIN earned
             CROSS JOIN er
             CROSS JOIN peak
             CROSS JOIN peakdate
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Statistics ID",
            a."Total Profit",
            a."Outstanding Principal",
            a."Total Outstanding Principal",
            a."Active Loans",
            a."Today's Profit",
            a."Yesterday's Profit",
            a."Realized Profit MTD",
            a."Projected Monthly Profit",
            a."Pending Payment Amount",
            a."Forecast Remaining Interest",
            a."Today's Outstanding Interest",
            a."Net Principal Days MTD",
            a."Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
            a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
            a."Peak Cash Pool 30D",
            a."Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
            a."Expected Daily Interest",
            a."Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
            a."Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
            a."Total Cash Pool",
            a."Total Unsettled Profit",
            a."Expected Loan Account Balance",
            a."Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
            a."Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
            a."Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
            a."Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
            a."Borrowers Not Paid Today",
            a."Amount Due Today",
            a."Amount Collected Today",
            a."Amount Outstanding Today",
            a."Amount Collection Rate Today",
            a."Total Business Expenses",
            a."Net Profit",
            a."Expenses MTD",
            a."Net Profit MTD",
            a."Net Unsettled Profit",
            a."Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
            a."Operating Income MTD",
            a."Income Statement Expenses MTD",
            a."Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment",
                CASE
                    WHEN a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN a."Projected Monthly Profit" / a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal"
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Forecast Monthly Return on ADO"
           FROM a
        )
 SELECT "Row ID",
    "Statistics ID",
    round("Total Profit", 0) AS "Total Profit",
    round("Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Outstanding Principal",
    "Active Loans",
    round("Today's Profit", 0) AS "Today's Profit",
    round("Yesterday's Profit", 0) AS "Yesterday's Profit",
    round("Realized Profit MTD", 0) AS "Realized Profit MTD",
    round("Projected Monthly Profit", 0) AS "Projected Monthly Profit",
    round("Pending Payment Amount", 0) AS "Pending Payment Amount",
    round("Forecast Remaining Interest", 0) AS "Forecast Remaining Interest",
    round("Today's Outstanding Interest", 0) AS "Today's Outstanding Interest",
    "Net Principal Days MTD",
    "Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
    round("Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
    round("Forecast Monthly Return on ADO", 2) AS "Forecast Monthly Return on ADO",
    round("Peak Cash Pool 30D", 0) AS "Peak Cash Pool 30D",
    "Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
    round("Expected Daily Interest", 0) AS "Expected Daily Interest",
    round("Total Profit of Outstanding Loans", 0) AS "Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
    round("Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal", 2) AS "Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
    round("Total Cash Pool", 0) AS "Total Cash Pool",
    round("Total Unsettled Profit", 0) AS "Total Unsettled Profit",
    round("Expected Loan Account Balance", 0) AS "Expected Loan Account Balance",
    round("Total Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Total Outstanding Principal",
    round("Top 3 Borrower Concentration", 4) AS "Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
    "Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
    "Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
    "Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
    "Borrowers Not Paid Today",
    round("Amount Due Today", 0) AS "Amount Due Today",
    round("Amount Collected Today", 0) AS "Amount Collected Today",
    round("Amount Outstanding Today", 0) AS "Amount Outstanding Today",
    "Amount Collection Rate Today",
    round("Total Business Expenses", 0) AS "Total Business Expenses",
    round("Net Profit", 0) AS "Net Profit",
    round("Expenses MTD", 0) AS "Expenses MTD",
    round("Net Profit MTD", 0) AS "Net Profit MTD",
    round("Net Unsettled Profit", 0) AS "Net Unsettled Profit",
    round("Net Expected Loan Account Balance", 0) AS "Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
    round("Income Statement Expenses MTD", 0) AS "Income Statement Expenses MTD",
    round("Operating Income MTD", 0) AS "Operating Income MTD",
    "Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment"
   FROM final x;

definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_chat_thread_update_v1(actor jsonb, id uuid, patch jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE partner text:=public.pwa_chat_actor_v1(actor); row_value public.pwa_chat_threads;
BEGIN
 IF patch IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(patch)<>'object' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(patch)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(patch) k WHERE k NOT IN ('title','model','status'))
  OR (patch ? 'title' AND (jsonb_typeof(patch->'title')<>'string' OR length(patch->>'title') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120 OR patch->>'title'<>btrim(patch->>'title') OR patch->>'title' ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))
  OR (patch ? 'model' AND (jsonb_typeof(patch->'model')<>'string' OR patch->>'model' !~ '^(gemini-[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?-[a-z0-9-]+|claude-[a-z]+-[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?)$' OR length(patch->>'model')>64))
  OR (patch ? 'status' AND (jsonb_typeof(patch->'status')<>'string' OR patch->>'status' NOT IN ('active','archived'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_request' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.pwa_chat_threads t SET title=coalesce(patch->>'title',t.title),model=coalesce(patch->>'model',t.model),status=coalesce(patch->>'status',t.status),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE t.id=$2 AND t.partner_id=partner RETURNING * INTO row_value;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
 RETURN public.pwa_chat_thread_json_v1(row_value);
END $function$
